long_biography.plain_text:
Jack Charles’s experience commissioning a custom yacht gave him the starting point for a new business. He established Crescent in a small coastal community in British Columbia, initially buying hulls from American shipyards and completing them in Canada for individual customers. A growing order book eventually required a larger production site in Richmond.

The business produced large custom motor yachts before being sold to investors in the early 2000s. Some of its skilled craftspeople remained in local marine work. Charles’s grandson Tim later brought the Crescent name back into the family through his own Platinum Marine business, combining the revived brand with an established refit operation.
